messages.subject: Error Combining Groups: Measurement Invariance
parts:
Hi all, 

I am trying to fit a model and am getting an error message I am not familiar with.  I am at the first step of measurement invariance and have used this code:

fit_model2 <- cfa(CFAmodel_1, 
                  data = Data,
                  group = "Race")

Race is represented in the dataset with two groups (1= Black, 2 = White). This is the error code I am getting: 

Error: Can't combine `..1` <character> and `..2` <double>. Backtrace: 1. lavaan::cfa(CFAmodel_1, data = Data, group = "Race") 4. lavaan::lavaan(...) 5. lavaan:::lavData(...) 6. lavaan:::lav_data_full(...) 8. vctrs:::`==.vctrs_vctr`(data[[group]], group.label[g]) ... 17. vctrs::vec_ptype2(x, vec_data(y), ...) 19. vctrs::vec_default_ptype2(...) 20. vctrs::stop_incompatible_type(...) 21. vctrs:::stop_incompatible(...) 22. vctrs:::stop_vctrs(...)

I imported the data using SPSS and its my first time getting this error. Any advice?
